data.one_liner: A widget that triggers an action when a secret gesture or keyboard combination is detected.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a single widget called EasterEggTrigger that listens for a customizable sequence of gestures or keyboard keys. When the exact combination is matched, it calls a provided callback function. By default, it uses the Konami code combination.
use_when: You want to hide secret Easter eggs behind specific gesture combinations.
You want to trigger debug menus or hidden features using keyboard shortcuts or gestures.
avoid_when: You need standard navigation or gesture handling for primary app features.
strengths: Supports both touch gestures and keyboard keys.
Comes with a default Konami code configuration out of the box.
Easy to wrap around any existing widget.
weaknesses: Limited to gesture and key combination triggers.
No documentation provided for advanced configuration beyond the basic examples.
